name: Important National Days
summary: Commemorative national days, anniversaries, and associated historical events.
concept: Questions in competitive exams test knowledge of key national observances: National Youth Day (12 Jan), Republic Day (26 Jan), National Science Day (28 Feb), National Panchayati Raj Day (24 Apr), Kargil Vijay Diwas (26 Jul), National Sports Day (29 Aug), Hindi Diwas (14 Sep), National Unity Day (31 Oct), and Constitution Day (26 Nov).

subtopics.name: National Observances & Significance
subtopics.summary: Dates, origins, historical context, and themes.

facts.title: National Science Day (28 February)
facts.content: Commemorates the discovery of the Raman Effect by Sir C. V. Raman on 28 February 1928, for which he received the 1930 Nobel Prize in Physics.

facts.title: Constitution Day (26 November)
facts.content: Commemorates the adoption of the Constitution of India by the Constituent Assembly on 26 November 1949, officially instituted in 2015.

mcqs.exp: National Voters' Day has been observed annually on 25 January since 2011 to mark the founding anniversary of the Election Commission of India on 25 January 1950 and encourage democratic electoral participation.

mcqs.q: Samvidhan Diwas (Constitution Day) is celebrated annually on which date to mark the adoption of the Constitution by the Constituent Assembly?
mcqs.questionText: Samvidhan Diwas (Constitution Day) is celebrated annually on which date to mark the adoption of the Constitution by the Constituent Assembly?
mcqs.qHi: संविधान सभा द्वारा संविधान को अंगीकृत किए जाने के उपलक्ष्य में प्रतिवर्ष 'संविधान दिवस' किस तिथि को मनाया जाता है?
mcqs.questionTextHi: संविधान सभा द्वारा संविधान को अंगीकृत किए जाने के उपलक्ष्य में प्रतिवर्ष 'संविधान दिवस' किस तिथि को मनाया जाता है?
mcqs.exp: On 26 November 1949, the Constituent Assembly of India adopted the Constitution of India. In 2015 (Dr. B.R. Ambedkar's 125th birth anniversary year), the Government of India declared 26 November as Constitution Day.
mcqs.explanation: On 26 November 1949, the Constituent Assembly of India adopted the Constitution of India. In 2015 (Dr. B.R. Ambedkar's 125th birth anniversary year), the Government of India declared 26 November as Constitution Day.
mcqs.expHi: 26 नवंबर 1949 को संविधान सभा ने भारतीय संविधान को अंगीकृत, अधिनियमित और आत्मार्पित किया था। 2015 से प्रतिवर्ष 26 नवंबर को 'संविधान दिवस' मनाया जाता है।
mcqs.explanationHi: 26 नवंबर 1949 को संविधान सभा ने भारतीय संविधान को अंगीकृत, अधिनियमित और आत्मार्पित किया था। 2015 से प्रतिवर्ष 26 नवंबर को 'संविधान दिवस' मनाया जाता है।
mcqs.hint: Not Republic Day (26 Jan), but the date of its formal adoption in 1949.
mcqs.hintHi: 26 नवंबर 1949 को संविधान अंगीकृत किया गया था।
